# Food

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

A source of nutrition for something eaten as a meal or snack.

## Scope note

A parent context for recipes, products, packages, and ingredients that might be included in a meal or snack.

## Broader

- [Meal](../Meal/) — partitive (ISO 25964)

- [Product](../Product/)
